entities.summary: Mikhail "Misha" Arkadyevich Shifman is a theoretical physicist, formerly at the Institute for Theoretical and Experimental Physics, Moscow, currently Ida Cohen Fine Professor of Theoretical Physics, William I. Fine Theoretical Physics Institute, University of Minnesota.
